displayName: CLOR backup: no successful run in 7 hours

documentation.content: The off-host backup job clor-backup has not succeeded for 7 hours. It runs every 6 hours, so at least one run was missed or failed, including the case where Cloud Scheduler never started it. Runbook: docs/BACKUP-AND-RESTORE.md.

conditions.displayName: clor-backup: no succeeded execution for 7 h

conditionAbsent.filter: resource.type = "cloud_run_job" AND resource.labels.job_name = "clor-backup" AND metric.type = "run.googleapis.com/job/completed_execution_count" AND metric.labels.result = "succeeded"
